problem.title: The Friction in Scaling High-Impact Teams
problem.subtitle: Growing tech companies face three consistent bottlenecks when building engineering teams.
problem.card1_description: Top-tier AI and engineering talent is rare — and heavily competed for. The candidates you need aren't browsing job boards.
problem.card2_description: Generic recruiters can't evaluate technical fit. You spend weeks interviewing the wrong profiles, burning your team's time and momentum.
problem.card3_description: Every week without the right hire delays product, slows growth, and puts mounting pressure on the rest of your team.

about.title: Founder-Led. Culture-Obsessed.
about.subtitle: We plug into your team, learn how you build, and find the people who'll make it better.
about.bio: PeopleFirst Talent Partners (formerly PeopleFirst Agency) is a tech recruiting boutique founded by Carla Costantini in Buenos Aires, Argentina. We help startups and scale-ups across LATAM and the US hire senior Engineering, Data, AI and AdTech talent. Our work starts before the first outreach. We get to know your product, how your team works and what the company needs next. Culture is the first filter, and the last one. Add Carla's background in Psychology, and every candidate gets read for more than their stack.
about.credential1: 7+ years sourcing Engineering, Data, AI & AdTech talent
about.credential2: Talent networks across LATAM, the US and Europe
about.credential3: Tech talent placed at Series A to unicorn-stage companies
about.credential4: Every shortlist filtered for skills and culture fit

process.title: How We Work
process.step1_description: We go deep on role scope, team dynamics, and culture fit before sourcing a single candidate.
process.step2_description: We don't post and pray. We map the market, identify passive candidates, and craft personalized outreach.
process.step3_description: We sell your company's vision and product — not just the job. Top engineers choose PeopleFirst because we tell your story right.
